mapper.sql: select qa_id, user_id, user_name, question, answer, reference_resource_ids, reference_titles, model_name, cost_millis, create_by, create_time, remark from ai_qa_log
mapper.select: and user_id = #{userId}and user_name like concat('%', #{userName}, '%')and question like concat('%', #{question}, '%') order by qa_id desc
mapper.insert: insert into ai_qa_log(user_id, user_name, question, answer, reference_resource_ids, reference_titles, model_name, cost_millis, create_by, create_time, remark) values(#{userId}, #{userName}, #{question}, #{answer}, #{referenceResourceIds}, #{referenceTitles}, #{modelName}, #{costMillis}, #{createBy}, sysdate(), #{remark})
mapper.delete: delete from ai_qa_log where qa_id in #{qaId}
